== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[It Can Wait (Japanese)|It Can Wait]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/151452842/LRYmwNo2wkyu4tQ2EER3og.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 85187825.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>8021379f8e47948d1d253fd1ef03a961ddcbbc633910b8c6c97b90c93c55dd06</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
